description: This file contains a class GatewayEventHandler that manages wake words synchronization with a gateway, including scheduling updates, handling incoming data, and communicating with the gateway session.

classes.name: GatewayEventHandler
classes.description: Handles wake words synchronization with the gateway, including requesting, updating, and processing wake words data.

methods.name: applyWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Updates wake words in preferences and temporarily suppresses sync.

methods.name: scheduleWakeWordsSyncIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules an update to sync wake words with the gateway if connected and not suppressed.

methods.name: refreshWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Requests wake words from the gateway and applies them.

methods.name: handleVoiceWakeChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming wake word change events from payload JSON.
